name: Flower
overview: Scripture uses the imagery of flowers and grass to illustrate the fleeting nature of human life and earthly beauty, as seen in Isaiah 40:6-7 where all flesh is compared to grass and the flower of the field that withers and fades under the breath of the Lord. This transient quality underscores human frailty in contrast to the enduring word of God, which alone remains forever unchanging and steadfast, as affirmed in Isaiah 40:8.
